summary: Full pre-launch regression of The Corner Model 2.0. Backend: rewrote /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py into 54 pytest cases covering auth gating (12 protected routes + invalid/expired token), /api/leagues (14 leagues w/ data_source+season), teams (splits/windows), matchups (side re-rank, projection, tiers), fixtures + fixture detail (splits/recent/real_samples), odds merge + EV formula + tier, scanner (sort/filters/EV formula), streaks (threshold, min_hits, side, window, within_days), trends (metric/side/scope, delta>0 + sort), best-bets, top-mismatches, refresh (returns in <5s), bankroll and bet lifecycle. 54/54 pass. Frontend: verified login gating, cookie auth, root->/scanner redirect, Value Finder (3 best-bet cards, 7 mismatch rows, 489 scanner rows, filters, row->fixture nav), Leagues (league switcher, matchup side toggle re-rank, Mismatch/Lean badges, split/window tabs, refresh toast), Streaks (Hot Form side/window/metric/scope; Consistency side/preset/threshold/timeframe/scope + Edge column + empty state), Fixture detail (inline odds EV recalc, quick-paste parse, persistence after reload, split tabs, Last 5/10 toggle, real-sample badge), nav tabs, back button, logout. Only 2 minor cosmetic issues found; no functional breakage.

minor.issue: No concurrency guard - each click spawns a new sync_real.py subprocess. Repeated clicks (or a user spamming Refresh data) can launch many parallel API-Football syncs and burn quota. Suggest an in-progress flag per league.
N+1 sequential Mongo query pattern (_odds_for called once per fixture inside the loop). Works today (~140 fixtures, ~1.5s) but will degrade as fixtures grow; batch with a single $in query.

issues: Copy says 'Auto-updating Poisson model across 7 leagues' but the app now serves 14 leagues (src/pages/Login.jsx:32). Visible on the public landing page - should be fixed before launch.

Horizontal overflow: document.scrollWidth = 440 on a 390px viewport. The header (logo + 3 nav icons + league switcher + avatar/logout) does not fit; the league switcher and logout are pushed off-screen and the whole page scrolls sideways.
Parser only accepts TOTAL corner lines (label says so). Pasting 'Home Over 4.5 2.05' is silently ignored with no feedback - consider supporting team lines or showing 'x of y lines parsed'.

action_items: Update Login.jsx copy from '7 leagues' to '14 leagues' before public launch.
Fix mobile (<=390px) header horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 440 vs 390).
Add an in-progress guard to POST /api/leagues/{id}/refresh so repeated clicks don't spawn parallel API-Football syncs.
Optional: batch odds lookups in /api/scanner and /api/leagues/{id}/fixtures to remove the N+1 query loop.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 869 lines (>700 threshold) - split into modules (poisson/model, auth, routes: leagues, fixtures, scanner, streaks, bets).

seed_data() still seeds the legacy 7 synthetic leagues/teams when the DB is empty; on a fresh deploy (e.g. production) the app would start with mock data and mock team names until sync_real.py runs. Ensure the real sync runs on first boot or gate the synthetic seed behind an env flag.

_real_avg() silently falls back to the full (overall) match pool when a team has no games at the requested venue, so a column labelled 'AWAY CORNERS /G' can actually be showing overall form with no indication to the user.

matchups league_avg_won and _all_mismatches league_avgs are computed with _src(), which includes synthetic matches for the ~60/280 teams that still have zero real games - this mixes synthetic numbers into the 'real data' league baseline used for strong/decent tiering.
POST /api/auth/logout only deletes the session when the cookie is present; a Bearer-token client cannot log out (token stays valid for 7 days).
Duplicated 'earliest upcoming fixture per team' logic exists both in _next_fixtures() and inline in /api/streaks (~12 lines) - DRY violation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (54 tests, pytest-xdist parallel, ~5s). It self-provisions a session via pymongo. Do NOT click logout in a Playwright run before other tests - it deletes the session row and invalidates the shared token for the rest of the run (run logout last). Note that Playwright inner_text() does not include <input> values on fixture-detail market rows; use page.input_value('[data-testid="odds-input-<key>"]'). Avoid triggering more than one /refresh (real API-Football calls).
rca_of_the_issue: Login copy '7 leagues' is a leftover from the original 7-league MVP (same origin as the legacy LEAGUES constant in seed_data). Mobile overflow is caused by the fixed-width league switcher (w-[180px]) plus nav items in a single non-wrapping header row in Layout.jsx.
